gloss: competitive spirit; rivalry; desire to compete

definitions.gloss: competitive spirit; rivalry; desire to compete
definitions.explanation: The feeling of wanting to compete with or outdo someone else. Can be positive (healthy competition) or negative (petty rivalry), depending on context.

examples.japanese: {対抗心|たいこうしん}を{燃|も}やす。
{彼|かれ}はライバルに{対|たい}して{強|つよ}い{対抗心|たいこうしん}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: He has a strong sense of rivalry toward his competitor.

examples.japanese: {対抗心|たいこうしん}から{相手|あいて}の{意見|いけん}に{反対|はんたい}してしまうことがある。
examples.english: Sometimes I end up opposing the other person's opinion out of sheer competitiveness.

notes:
USAGE:
{対抗心|たいこうしん} is a compound of {対抗|たいこう} (opposition, rivalry) and {心|しん} (heart, spirit). It describes an internal feeling of wanting to rival or outperform someone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対抗心|たいこうしん}を{燃|も}やす (to burn with competitive spirit)
- {対抗心|たいこうしん}を{持|も}つ (to have a competitive spirit)
- {対抗心|たいこうしん}を{剥|む}き{出|だ}しにする (to openly show one's rivalry)
- {対抗心|たいこうしん}から (out of rivalry/competitiveness)
